verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents dedicated Teams Export APIs that explicitly cover 1:1, group chat, meeting chats, and channel messages, including recovering deleted messages for up to 21 days — directly matching the compliance-export story, and Graph's machine-readable OData schema backs this. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of an admin actually running a full-tenant export and details on private-chat access policy gating (e.g. eDiscovery/compliance role requirements) are not spelled out beyond the docs snippet.
